desc:
🍜 WELCOME TO MIE GADOAN TYCOON!

Ready to build your own noodle empire?

Start with a small noodle shop and turn it into the most successful restaurant in town! Serve hungry customers, earn money, upgrade your restaurant, and expand your business.

FEATURES:

🍜 Cook and serve delicious noodle dishes.
💰 Earn money from happy customers.
🏗️ Build and upgrade your restaurant.
🪑 Expand your restaurant with new facilities.
🚀 Grow your business and become a noodle tycoon!

Your support means a lot to us! Please consider giving the game a LIKE 👍 and FAVORITE ⭐ to support our development.

Can you build the biggest noodle empire? 🍜


Mie Gadoan Tycoon is still under development! New features, improvements, and exciting content are coming soon.
